entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add AddDbContextFactory overload with explicit DbContextOptions lifetime #38669
  • Unify Relational and Cosmos JSON serialization implementation #38664
    Backlog

Closed

  • Remove or internalize JSON.NET dependency in Cosmos Provider #14570
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Modernize our JSON serialization/deserialization #34567
    Backlog
  • Cosmos DB: 410 Gone (Substatus 1002) - PartitionKeyRangeGone with Hierarchical Partitioning #38032
    11.0.0
  • Entity splitting with Complex Property throws InvalidOperationException #38077
    11.0.0
  • Problem masking & unhelpful exception when loading entity with inconsistent data in owned entity columns #38223
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Bump actions/upload-code-coverage from 1.3.0 to 1.4.0 #38670
    area-infrastructure
  • Query: lift GroupBy aggregates over reference navigations into pre-GroupBy joins #38668
    community-contribution
  • Fix DetectChanges throwing when nullable nested complex property with nested collection is set to null #38667
  • Fix JsonReaderData buffer refill to respect valid bytes on partial stream reads #38666
  • Fix OPENJSON `AS JSON` failure on Azure SQL when column type is `json` at compat level 170 #38665

Merged

  • Cosmos: Modernize serialization in query pipeline #38662
    community-contribution
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • Add `NoBuild` parameter to `Add-Migration` PMC command #38658
  • Fix complex property projection for entity splitting mappings #38592

Updated

  • Cosmos: flow transactional batch failures through the execution strategy so they can be retried #38597
  • Handle out-of-order split-include rows to prevent child collection loss under concurrent inserts #38590
